what_happened: The person running Athena counted the records/jobs verification files at 19:00 UTC on 12 Nov. The evidence rule "criterion evidence must cite commands that ran (D43)" was among the reasons for 6 rejections in 36 hours: effort-split line, restarts try 1, specialization (twice), role needs retry, and prevention check retry. The steward had already queued an item on 11 Nov at 12:19 UTC saying this rule misfires when a command ran and failed. That item has no decision. No job failed in this event. The person running Athena reported it and did not change the rule by hand.
cause: Athena does not track how often a verdict rule contributes to rejections, and it does not link a steward's report of a rule defect to the rejections that rule causes. The item had no decision and no trigger to escalate it, so the rule stayed unchanged while it kept rejecting jobs.
other_causes: Rule D43 may treat 'cites a command that ran' as 'cites a command that passed', so valid evidence from a failed command is refused.
Queue order is by age and tier, so the steward's fix item likely waits behind the backlog (see earlier cases on priority inflation).
open_hypotheses: Whether all 6 rejections were caused by D43 misfiring on failed commands, or whether some also had real evidence gaps. The fields list D43 only as one of the reasons.
Whether the steward item is queued as a job, or is only a note waiting for a decision.
contradictions: gate_counts show the verifier gate with 158 ends and 0 disagreements, so there is no measured sign that its rule was wrong.
D43 is counted as one of the reasons for each rejection, not the sole reason, so some rejections may have been right.
prevention: Add a standing check that counts, from the verification records, how many rejections in a window cite each verdict rule. When a rule reaches a set count (for example 3 in 36 hours) and an open steward item names that rule with no decision, the check puts that item on the owner's decisions page with the count and the question to decide. Relaxing D43 is not supported yet: the verifier gate has 158 ends and 0 disagreements, so no later try has landed a change it ended.
proposed_request: Add a standing check that counts, per verdict rule (such as D43), how many job rejections in the last 36 hours cite that rule, using the verification files under records/jobs. Show the counts on the decisions page. When a rule is cited in 3 or more rejections and a steward item that names it has no decision, list that item at the top of the owner's decisions page with the count and the question to decide. Acceptance: a test over fixtures taken from the six real rejections of 11 to 12 Nov (effort-split line, restarts try 1, specialization twice, role needs retry, prevention check retry) shows D43 counted six times and the 11 Nov 12:19 UTC steward item raised. Add the CHANGELOG.md entry.
